items.expected_text: refactor proposals appear in the backlog within the first week of runs; T9 origination share rises as they archive. Health metric: T9 origination share and user-prompted intervention count in the next `openspec_gate health` run. T5 is protected rather than moved: decision-path refactors ship only behind a golden equivalence test.

no health-metric threshold changes by itself (observability + evaluation-surface change); new `t9_autonomy_share_trend_delta` and `t9_prompt_evolution_t12_delta` telemetry numbers appear after the first post-change prompt-evolution slot; GUI Growth view populated with the full archive history (all `archive:` commits to date) on first deploy.

`t14_challengers_evaluated_7d` (UNMEASURED today) gains an evaluated challenger once task 3 runs. The T12 hit-rate metrics move only if a promoted budget change follows. Health metric: `t14_challengers_evaluated_7d` in the next `health` run after task 4.

no change to any live score, action or size (weight 0.0, never in `composite_10000`). The live-IC table (`data/live_category_ic.jsonl`) gains a `news_hardness` row once ≥ 4 weekly sections carry it. Health metric: the live category-IC table in the engineer prompt; T12 moves only if a later promotion proposal passes. No risk invariant changes.

is MISS → MET on Monday 00:00–12:00 UTC snapshots, unchanged on every other day. This is a measurement correction, not an outcome improvement: the numerator (the scorecard file for the just-completed week) is unchanged, the generator is unchanged, and no capability gap is hidden, because the pulse writes the scorecard the same morning and the grace ends at noon. Health metric: `t5_weekly_scorecard_present` in `python -m investor.openspec_gate health`.

T12 HIGH stays MISS under the new definition (lift −1.5 pp mean today versus a proposed +5 pp bar). It becomes an *actionable* MISS: the gap is 6 pp of real edge, not 45 pp of arithmetic. Health metrics: `t12_conviction_{high,medium,low}_hit_rate_clustered` change their graded value from an absolute rate to a lift once ratified. Indirectly this moves **T14 (Learning rate)**, because each challenger gets judged on lift, so a challenger that improves selection becomes visible. It also makes T12 consistent with **T13**, which is already graded universe-relative.

`t9_weekly_strategy_output` goes from UNMEASURED to MET or MISS every week. Health metric: that one, on the first run after landing. The 2026-10-11 slot was skipped, so the next engineer run takes the strategy pass.

universe-scope vetoes fall from 35 per 12 days to 0 once the cache turns over. Real leverage and coverage vetoes are unchanged. Health metric: no existing metric isolates this. The DATA_WATCH recount (task 4) is the measurement. The holdings-card confidence in the next report will also show it.

risk_officer_veto concerns on new audit rows fall by roughly 80% once the 7-day cache turns over. Real-risk vetoes (leverage, interest coverage) remain. Health metric: no existing metric tracks veto counts; the DATA_WATCH re-count (task 4) is the measurement. T12 conviction hit rates will reflect it only after the 13-week horizon. Also **T5**: the bumped prompt version on each persisted result makes the correction auditable.
